fact_previews: The project 'Cooking Py: Learning, as easy as pie!' was created by Aneesh Chakko.
The project aims to help users learn Spanish or Python while cooking simple recipes.
The funding period for the project was from January 24, 2021, to February 25, 2021.
The project raised CA$ 1,897 from 15 backers.
The project had a funding goal of CA$ 1,500.

fact_previews: The project involves relating kitchen items, like a blender, to coding concepts, such as libraries.
The team designed a video to share coding concepts while making a simple blueberry pancake smoothie.
The first video can be found at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IgXq6NYB0ss&ab_channel=CookingPy.
The team decided to create additional videos after receiving positive feedback from friends.
The third video translates the ingredients of the smoothie into Spanish to help non-Spanish speakers learn.

The team designs all the videos and the website end to end.
The biggest challenge for the team is to consistently deliver a fun user experience with every new content.
